thread:
samir: FYI SparkCorp escalated — they want a 99.9% latency SLA + dedicated capacity as a renewal condition. Legal deadline EOM. Do we bend roadmap for this?

maya: can we get numbers from sales? what's renewal $ and churn risk if we say no?

jordan: sales says $450k ARR, 3yr renewal. they flagged 60% churn risk if we don't commit something.

elaine-p: that's material. but we can't rewrite infra roadmap for one account without clear guardrails. propose we use a prioritization framework (RICE) + a short mitigation plan.

maya: agreed. quick RICE sketch:
```
Reach: medium (10 similar mid-enterprise accounts)
Impact: high for renewal (score 4)
Confidence: 60% (sales estimate)
Effort: infra + ops ~7w (4w infra + 3w eng)
RICE ~= (10*4*0.6)/7 = 3.43
```

jordan: that score doesn't scream "cut roadmap". alternative: paid SLA add-on + dedicated pilot (lower effort).

samir: +1 on pilot. can we offer a limited dedicated pool + promote to dedicated contract if they convert? keeps roadmap intact and buys time.

eng-platform-bot: @eng-platform estimate request received: please respond with ballpark effort and risk by 10:00 AM PT tomorrow.

elaine-p: recommendation: 1) Offer pilot (90 days) as a paid add-on with 99.5% SLA on dedicated capacity. 2) Commit to evaluating full 99.9% SLA after pilot and only if we see consistent traffic pattern and justified unit economics. 3) Update sales T&Cs (SLA carve-outs for abuse and realistic latency windows).

maya: this preserves roadmap velocity and sets a clear launch criteria for full SLA. we'll need a short spec doc and cost/price calc for the pilot. I can draft the spec.

jordan: Sales can accept pilot if we give them a crisp customer-facing one-pager and pricing. they want a yes/no by EOD tomorrow to hit renewal timeline.

samir: i'll draft the decision note with the RICE appendix and hand to sales. @eng-platform can you confirm whether 4w infra + 3w eng is plausible or if it's more? need ballpark by 10am. :thumbsup:

eng-platform-bot: ack, estimating. risk: dependency on KV-cache refactor and autoscaler thresholds. preliminary note: 6-8w likely; will confirm tomorrow.

elaine-p: if estimate is >8w we reframe: offer SLA + conservative uptime targets (99.5) plus migration plan. don't promise 99.9 yet.

maya: fine. next steps: (1) eng-platform confirm effort by 10am, (2) maya to draft spec & pricing, (3) samir to draft decision note for sales. can we close this thread with a go/no-go by noon tomorrow?

jordan: syncing with account exec now. i'll push for pilot acceptance.

samir: thanks everyone. keeping tradeoff explicit: short-term paid pilot vs long-term roadmap rework. we'll use RICE + unit-econ check to decide.

elaine-p: +1. document assumptions in the decision note (reach, impact, confidence, effort). helps future similar asks.

samir: I'll post the decision note here when ready.
